title: Drill 2 - check the error
intro: `os.WriteFile` returns an error, and `save` drops it. Wrap the call in an `if` that returns the error. The goal is shown below the code.

`if err := f(); err != nil {` runs `f` and checks its error in one statement, and keeps `err` scoped to the `if`. `I` inserts before the first non-blank character and `A` appends at the end of the line; after a `{`, Enter indents the next line, and a `}` typed first on a line lines up with its `{`.
